default.description: Main window capability set. Grants core defaults plus the dialog and store plugins. Custom app commands (cmd_*) are local to the window and need no plugin permission. See docs/tech/modules/tauri-ipc-contract.md.

palette.description: Command palette window. Core defaults plus its own window show/hide/focus and cross-window event emit/listen for navigation. Custom app commands (cmd_*) are cross-window and need no plugin permission.
